import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

im1 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0001.png'))
# Sofa is on left side of obs1: u in [0, 150], v in [300, 400]
# Sofa back/bottom edge
mask = (np.abs(im1[:,:,0].astype(int) - 110) < 40) & (np.abs(im1[:,:,1].astype(int) - 116) < 40) & (np.abs(im1[:,:,2].astype(int) - 124) < 40)
coords = np.argwhere(mask)
coords = [c for c in coords if c[1] < 150 and c[0] > 300]

import pandas as pd
df = pd.DataFrame(coords, columns=['v', 'u'])
bottoms = df.groupby('u')['v'].max()

print('obs1 sofa bottom v min:', bottoms.min(), 'max:', bottoms.max())
print('Corner at u max:', df['u'].max(), bottoms.loc[df['u'].max()])
